objective: Given a short Arabic audio clip, predict its dialect region for ADI optimization.

MGB2_parquet.justification: ADI17 train currently covers the 5 non-MSA target regions but does not provide a dedicated MSA class, so MGB2_parquet is the only controlled MSA supervision source in the whitelist.

large_dataset_staging.notes: Large training data should be uploaded from GPU workers to object storage with rclone, then materialized under /data on ECO. Avoid rsync/scp for large transfers.

acoustic_only_baseline_v1.notes: Official baseline track until transcript quality, coverage, and leakage controls are frozen.

dual_stream_controlled_transcript_v1.activation_condition: Enable only after train/dev transcript coverage and anti-leakage policy are frozen.

whitelist.name: Local
whitelist.notes: Final gold-eval dataset curated locally. Processed JSONL files already carry normalized region_label fields, mirrored audio is available on local-controller, and this dataset must never enter training.

whitelist.name: ADI17
whitelist.notes: Primary supervised ADI source with explicit dialect labels that can be mapped to 6 regions.

whitelist.name: MGB2_parquet
whitelist.notes: Current example parquet exposes only the MSA label in the train split, so it is treated as an MSA-only augmentation source rather than a second full multi-class supervision set.

whitelist.name: NADI2025_subtask1_SLID
whitelist.notes: Spoken dialect ID adaptation split suitable for fine-tuning and validation.

whitelist.name: MADIS5-spoken-arabic-dialects
whitelist.notes: Cross-domain evaluation set with 5 macro dialect classes aligned to the target task except for Mesopotamian.

whitelist.name: Casablanca
whitelist.notes: Country-specific evaluation-only resource cached via Hugging Face datasets.

graylist.name: MGB3
graylist.reason: Current local parquet does not expose an explicit dialect label, so using it as Egyptian supervision would be an assumption that must be verified.

graylist.name: MGB5
graylist.reason: Current local parquet does not expose an explicit dialect label, so using it as North Africa supervision would be an assumption that must be verified.

blocked.name: MGB2
blocked.reason: Raw ASR tar archives are not the preferred input to the ADI control loop when a labeled parquet conversion already exists.

blocked.name: QASR
blocked.reason: This resource is not currently structured as a dialect-region classification dataset.

blocked.name: ADI5_wav_raw_pool
blocked.reason: The current Local gold sets include subsets sourced from ADI5_wav train/validation, so the upstream ADI5_wav pool must stay blocked from training until exact overlap removal is implemented.
